title: 195 mm Clamp Head Replacement
author: user_53420366
description:
This is a **replacement clamp head** based on the original design that came with my clamp.

The original head broke, while the rest of the clamp was still perfectly usable, so I redesigned the head from scratch using my basic CAD skills.

In the photos:

- The **rounded head** is the original part (for reference)
- The **more angular version** is my redesigned model (this upload)

I intentionally **removed the internal cavity** that was present in the original part, as I believe this makes the replacement **stronger and more durable**.

This model is designed to fit **Parkside clamps and common AliExpress clamps** with a **total clamp length of 195 mm** (measured from the top of the clamp to the bottom).

Printing notes:

- Print in **PETG or ABS** for better strength
- Use **high infill** (≥40%)
- No supports needed

If someone with more advanced skills wants to **remix or smooth the design**, feel free — I’d love to see improved versions shared back with the community.

Happy printing! 🙂
